domain.text: Tooling for task-flow verbs and gateway operations in the vmethod CLI.

impressions.text: The work adds task opening, review, merge, and release-hold flows, with safeguards for owner approval, trusted CI, merge state, and stopped workers.
The worker reported broad verification, including 351 offline tests and passing build and CI checks; the orchestrator independently verified the full local check and live watch and board commands.
Review caught integration conflicts and a board timestamp parsing issue, which the worker resolved while retaining existing operation sets and adding regression coverage.
A pre-existing child-process test timeout occurred under load; the final full suite passed without increasing timeouts or weakening assertions.
The orchestrator did not run the task-flow commands live because they can create or merge real pull requests, and said the first live use would be watched closely.
